name: class
title: Add CSS State to Class
description: Adds or updates pseudo-states and the is-active class state at an explicit CSS location. Pair active and is-active for a shared action-atom skin.

settings.name: location
settings.title: CSS Location
settings.description: CSS file path, or a folder containing one unique stylesheet with the class.

settings.name: state
settings.title: State
settings.description: hover, active, is-active, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, disabled, checked, or visited. Use active, is-active to share one rule. Colon/dot prefixes are accepted.

settings.name: styles
settings.title: Styles
settings.description: CSS declarations or a JSON property/value object.
